meta.name: agent-orchestration-advisor
meta.description: Design multi-agent AI workflows with clear boundaries, handoffs, and monitoring. Use when a complex PM task should run as parallel specialized agents instead of one linear process.

copy.tagline: 设计多智能体协作流程，明确边界与交接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中协调多个AI智能体分工合作
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-agent workflows with clear boundaries and handoffs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate multiple AI agents in a project

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你将复杂的重复性任务拆解为多个并行运行的专用 AI 智能体，并设计智能体之间的边界、交接和人工审核点，以及设置启动控制塔监控。
howto.when: 当你描述一个每周耗时 5 小时以上的重复性 PM 任务（如竞品分析、客户反馈综合），或要求将线性流程重构为并行智能体系统时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个竞品情报的智能体工作流。
say.note: Claude 会引导你分解任务并分配智能体。

say.text: 我们现在的 AI 流程是一个巨大的顺序提示链，帮我重新架构成编排系统。
say.note: Claude 会分析当前流程并建议并行化方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you to break down complex repetitive tasks into multiple parallel specialized AI agents, design agent boundaries, handoffs, human review points, and set up launch control tower monitoring.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a repetitive PM task taking 5+ hours per week (e.g., competitive analysis, customer synthesis) or ask to re-architect a linear process into an orchestrated system.

say_en.text: Design an orchestrated workflow for competitive intelligence.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through task decomposition and agent assignment.

say_en.text: Our AI workflow is one giant sequential prompt chain—help me re-architect it.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the current flow and suggest parallelization.
